import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

workers = ['MA', 'MB', 'MC']
tasks = ['P1', 'P2', 'P3']
cost = {'MA': {'P1': 3000, 'P2': 3200, 'P3': 3100}, 'MB': {'P1': 2800, 'P2': 3300, 'P3': 2900}, 'MC': {'P1': 2900, 'P2': 3100, 'P3': 3000}}

m = gp.Model('Original_RAG_AP')
x = m.addVars(workers, tasks, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name='x')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(cost[i][j] * x[i, j] for i in workers for j in tasks), GRB.MINIMIZE)
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in tasks) == 1 for i in workers), name='worker')
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in workers) == 1 for j in tasks), name='project')

m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
    for variable in m.getVars():
        print(f'{variable.VarName}: {variable.X}')
else:
    print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')

Never assign optimize()'s return to m. Do not dispose the model or leave its context manager before the harness extracts the result. Printed objectives cannot replace this model object.
